title: Byte Pair Encoding
seoDescription: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) is a subword tokenization algorithm that iteratively merges the most frequent pair of adjacent symbols in a corpus.
description:
Identify most frequent adjacent character pairs across a corpus and iteratively merge them into subword units.

BPE dynamically constructs a subword vocabulary that balances word-level semantic meaning with character-level coverage.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
(c_1^*, c_2^*) = \arg\max_{(u, v)} \operatorname{Frequency}(u, v)
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Represent corpus words as tuples of characters appended with end-of-word tokens
2. Count occurrences of all adjacent symbol pairs across vocabulary
3. Merge the most frequent symbol pair into a single subword and repeat

### Returns
Dictionary with list of executed 'merges' and resulting 'vocabulary_size'.
